title: The Coin Safety Inspector
classification: Original authored Studio scene-contract and saved-motion continuation demonstration. No uploaded reference images; not an autonomous writing benchmark.
assembly: Three actual new-footage segments trimmed to exactly ten seconds (240 frames at 24 fps) each and concatenated at normal speed; original audio retained. No visual repairs or added overlays.

visual_review.method: One-second samples throughout all three scenes, plus four samples per second during the first five seconds of the handoff. Full video decoded by FFmpeg. This does not inspect every frame for visual correctness.
visual_review.observed: Mira raises one coin, offers it to seated Ivo, and ends empty-handed. Ivo remains seated in the samples, then places one visible coin on the bench and rests empty hands on his knees. Main colors, clothing and bench remain recognizable.
visual_review.limits: The stylized transfer does not reliably distinguish the prescribed left/right hands. The courtyard includes unrequested static door/window details, and subtle comic facial acting is limited. Ending inspection cannot certify every intervening frame or exact acting.

ending_checks.detail: Mira is standing left of the bench with her right hand raised to shoulder height, holding a single brass coin. Her teal coat, cream trousers, and brown boots match the intended appearance.
Ivo is seated on the right end of the bench with both hands resting on his knees. His red cap, gray shirt, and navy trousers match the intended appearance.
A single brass coin is visible in Mira's raised right hand.
The blue bench is stationary against the cream wall, with Ivo seated on its right end.
